referenceFunction.name: Water treatment plant, deionisation

technology.text: Plant with a production of 100 m3/h. Two-bed system with a strong acidic cation resin volume of 5.3 m3 and a strong base anion resin volume of 2.8 m3. Unit is operated with counterflow regeneration, a defgasser and without lime decarbonation. Life time of the unit 15 y and of the resin 5 y. 7500 h/a operating time. Tank material stainless steel, lining PP.

timePeriod.text: Time of literature publication. Measurements took place partly before this period.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data for resin volume based on design calculations for the specified water quality. Material demand estimated based on very weak data (one source). Land use estimated from literature data (one source). Standard distances used for transports.
